answer: Sealed-bid slot auctions make each fake key buy its seat against its own siblings. Each epoch 50 jade slots sell to the highest bids, every winner burns its bid, and every loser burns a delta of 10% of its bid. A farm bidding 100 fable keys at 4 POA wins at most 50 slots, so 50 winners burn 4 POA each and 50 losers burn 0.4 POA each. That is 200 + 20 = 220 POA, so 100 fakes x 2.2 POA = 220 POA burned, and the attacker pays 220 POA.
